name: Aircraft
comment: Types of Aircraft in the game - e.g. ORCA, A10 Warthog etc.

properties.name: IsFixedWing
properties.comment: Fixed wing aircraft (ones that cannot hover) have this flag set to true. Such aircraft will not vary speed while it is flying.

properties.name: IsLandable
properties.comment: Can this aircraft land? If it can land it is presumed to be controllable by the player.

properties.name: IsRotorEquipped
properties.comment: Does this aircraft have a rotor blade (helicopter) type propulsion?

properties.name: IsRotorCustom
properties.comment: Is there a custom rotor animation stage set for each facing of the aircraft?

properties.name: Type
properties.valid_values: NONE, TRANSPORT, A10, HELICOPTER, CARGO, ORCA

properties.name: Mission
properties.valid_values: NONE, SLEEP, ATTACK, MOVE, RETREAT, GUARD, STICKY, ENTER, CAPTURE, HARVEST, GUARD_AREA, RETURN, STOP, AMBUSH, HUNT, TIMED_HUNT, UNLOAD, SABOTAGE, CONSTRUCTION, DECONSTRUCTION, REPAIR, RESCUE, MISSILE
